plans.note: No liability/limitation heading appears in the outline; the indemnity section (sec-12) is the only likely home for any cap or damages exclusion. If none exists, we add a mutual cap with standard carve-outs (confidentiality, IP indemnity, willful misconduct).

Review sec-12 for direction: TrueLink must indemnify Client for third-party IP infringement claims arising from the licensed software and Hosting Services and for its own misconduct; Client's indemnity (if any, likely tied to sec-7/sec-8 covenants) stays narrow.

Client-side covenants (sec-8) and the licence grant (sec-2) are the usual places for restraints on our business; check for any bar on Client offering competing mortgage web services or using other hosts.
Scan sec-2 for exclusive-host/sole-source language and sec-8 for a covenant to route all traffic or lending products through TrueLink; we preserve the right to use other suppliers.
Compensation (sec-5) is where any best-pricing or best-terms clause would sit; MFN in our favour is fine, but any obligation on Client to give TrueLink most-favoured terms should be struck.
Look in Client covenants (sec-8) and near the confidentiality undertakings (sec-10) for hiring restrictions; if present, cap at 12 months with a general-advertising carve-out.

No term/termination section is listed in the supplied outline (numbering skips 3, 4, 6, 9, 11), so termination for convenience cannot be confirmed here; flag to add Client termination on 30–60 days' notice without penalty and to remove any vendor mid-term walk-away.
No term/renewal heading is supplied; check sec-5 for any renewal-linked fee escalator. Position: renewal only with capped uplift and a non-renewal notice window of no more than 30 days.

No general/miscellaneous section appears in the outline; governing law and venue likely sit in an unlisted tail section. Flag for insertion of New York, Delaware, California or England and Wales with court jurisdiction, not foreign arbitration.
Assignment is typically in the unlisted miscellaneous provisions; propose free assignment by Client to affiliates and successors and delete any TrueLink termination right on our change of control.

Check the licence grant and definitions (sec-2, sec-1) for ownership of customizations, look-and-feel and customer/borrower data generated through the Hosting Services, and sec-10 for any use rights over our Confidential Information; we retain ownership of our data and anything we pay for.
Primary target: sec-2 (grant scope) with defined terms in sec-1 — extend permitted use to Client affiliates and contractors and remove any right to revoke or suspend the licence at will.

Any usage-verification or records-inspection right against Client would sit in sec-8 or the compensation/reporting terms in sec-5; if present, limit to once annually, 10 business days' notice, off-site where practicable, at TrueLink's cost.

Check sec-5 for penalty interest or fixed damages payable by Client and sec-7 for per-message or stipulated penalties tied to the unsolicited e-mail covenant; convert to actual damages, and seek service credits from TrueLink instead.

The only warranty heading supplied runs the wrong way (sec-8 is Client's covenants and warranties); we need a reciprocal TrueLink performance warranty for the software and Hosting Services with a repair/replace-or-refund remedy, and any disclaimer in sec-2 narrowed.

No insurance provision appears in the outline even though TrueLink hosts our site and handles applicant data; flag to add commercial general liability, professional/E&O and cyber cover with certificates on request.
Review sec-5 for minimum fees, guaranteed volumes or shortfall true-ups binding Client; if present, pair with a termination right or shortfall credit rather than take-or-pay.

With no termination section supplied, the nearest hooks are the confidentiality return-of-materials duty (sec-10) and licence wind-down in sec-2; flag to add post-termination transition assistance and return of Client data in a usable format.
